text:
Devon (AE): Marlowe Systems sent an RFP this morning. They want an evaluation bundle that demonstrates on-prem inference, customer-managed keys, and embedding latency/throughput guarantees. RFP response due Tue EOD.
Priya (SE): Key asks? any acceptance criteria or eval dataset?
Devon (AE): Yes — they provided an evaluation corpus (legal-docs-2025) and an acceptance test: 95% of embedding similarity queries must return top-5 relevant results within 120ms p95. They also want POC pricing line items split out.
Omar (Solutions Eng): For the acceptance test we should recommend two options: (A) Private VPC deployment in their cloud region with KMS integration, (B) Air-gapped on-prem appliance image for full isolation. Option A faster; B needs infra ops on their side.
Janelle (Security): Security checklist: customer-managed KMS, HSM support (offline), key rotation, audit logs retention, PCI/PII redaction, vulnerability disclosure SLA. We should clarify telemetry separation and whether telemetry can be disabled in Private.
Priya (SE): Telemetry can be disabled in Private control plane; we have a flag in deploy config. I'll add exact config snippet.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Perf note: embeddings workload 50k req/day @ avg 512 tokens -> Dedicated pool with 2xA100 or 4xT4 equiv should meet throughput. p95 latency depends on batching. For p95 <120ms we'll recommend smaller batch sizes + prefix KV cache warmup. I'll run a quick sim.
Priya (SE): Tokenizer issue: they use a legacy BPE variant. Two paths: (1) include tokenizer in model bundle and serve it, (2) pre-tokenize client-side and send token ids. Pre-tokenize reduces integration time for POC. Document both.
Devon (AE): Procurement asked: can POC cost be split: infra (reserved), licensing (monthly eval license), professional services, and egress estimate? They want a line-item CSV.
Theo (Legal): Liability cap, data processing addendum, export controls, and IP ownership of evaluation outputs are typical asks. I'll prepare standard language but note we rarely assign IP on model outputs.
Janelle (Security): Certifications: SOC2 Type II yes; ISO27001 in progress. No FedRAMP. We can provide SOC2 report under NDA and an ISO roadmap. Also: we support customer-managed KMS in Private and BYO-HSM via PKCS#11 for on-prem.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Deployment diagram uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/attachments/marlowe-poc-topology-v2.png
Priya (SE): Quick example config for disabling telemetry: ```yaml telemetry: enabled: false``` Add to RFI answer.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Suggested rollback command for appliance image updates: `rdmctl appliance rollback --image <sha256>` Put in ops appendix.
Devon (AE): Marlowe asked about model explainability and hallucination controls in the RFP. They require human-review gating and an automated reranker for high-risk queries.
Priya (SE): We can recommend a reranker + confidence scorer and a human-in-the-loop gating step. Include sample pipeline and latency impact notes.
Janelle (Security): Also confirm data retention: default 90 days for POC, option to restrict to 30 days, and a guaranteed secure deletion command. We'll provide DPA snippet.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Cost ballpark for a 30-day Private pilot: infra reserved $22k-$38k (depends on GPU/instances) + SE services $10k one-time + optional appliance support $4k. I'll add low/med/high rows.
Devon (AE): They also want SLAs for production — for POC state we should say no production SLA, but show Dedicated SLA tiers available post-pilot.
Theo (Legal): I'll include sample SLA language and proposed liability cap tied to fees.
rfi-bot: RFP package draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/marlowe/rfp_answers_4299991111.pdf (SSO required).
Devon (AE): Action items: Priya - draft capability matrix mapping their columns (latency, retention, KMS, explainability). Omar - perf sims and cost scenarios + ops appendix. Janelle - security checklist + SOC2 NDA note. Theo - contract clause drafts. I'll assemble and send Tue AM.
Priya (SE): Got it, will post matrix by tomorrow 09:30.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Perf sims in progress; will post numbers and recommended instance types.
Janelle (Security): I'll attach SOC2 cover letter and KMS integration doc here once uploaded.
Theo (Legal): Starting on DPA + liability cap language, will loop in procurement.
Devon (AE): If Marlowe reaches out to any of you directly, please CC me. Thanks team :raised_hands:
